correctness.rationale: Proof: independence is equivalent to each consecutive clockwise selected gap >= k+1; two-step forward reachability exactly covers up to 2k, hence every gap <= 2k+1. Marked-vertex enumeration gives n/s bounded-composition coefficients; inclusion-exclusion gives the explicit binomial sum. Direct exhaustive enumeration for 90 parameter pairs matches. Checks include s=1 and k=n-1; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.
